user_query: Find the details of a specific song on Shazam using its ID. Also, provide me with the current date and time in America__Los_Angeles timezone. Additionally, fetch the details of the containing populated place for a specific place ID.

TaskList.description: Fetch song details from Shazam using the provided song ID.
Get the current date and time for the America__Los_Angeles timezone.
Fetch details of the populated place for the given place ID.
TaskList.dependency: This step requires the result from Subtask 2 to understand the context of the place.
